purpose: Fuse redundant Python decoder bookkeeping while preserving the exact graph, weights, vocabulary, greedy policy, authoritative token IDs, and byte output.

measured_redundancy: The same set of previously generated token IDs was reconstructed and mapped on every step.
The entire generated token prefix was decoded on every step only to determine whether the byte target had been reached.
The no-repeat n-gram successor table was rescanned from the full prefix on every step.

single_allowed_change.change: Maintain sequence-local seen-token indices and n-gram successor state incrementally; accumulate exact GPT-2 ByteLevel token bytes and invoke UTF-8 replacement decoding only near the byte boundary.
requirements: fall back to the existing general selection logic whenever a token-local map is not stable
validate the tokenizer decoder is ByteLevel before direct byte accumulation
include the exact runtime runner SHA-256 in emitted evidence

semantic_gate: All 40 scheduled output SHA-256 values, generated-token counts, routes, and cache lengths must equal the pre-change v30 sustained evidence exactly.
speed_gate: The unchanged sustained benchmark must pass every gate, including at least 95 percent sealed-parent throughput, at least 2x Qwen median, and paired bootstrap lower bound at least 2x.
failure_rule: If exact equivalence fails, reject the runtime change. If equivalence passes but speed fails, preserve the result and profile the ONNX graph; do not alter decoding semantics.
